mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.4% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.4% during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1150 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for durable goods, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in >40% of instances where HOUST < 1150 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production below 100 and housing starts below 1150 thousand units signals manufacturing and construction sector contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1150 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% during late-cycle expansion signals labor market tightening that accelerates inflation and equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >45% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.5% signals weak aggregate demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >55% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 1.5% during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% during monetary tightening cycles signals reduced liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in >40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in job growth below 100k and unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market strength that fuels consumer spending and equity earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where PAYEMS < 100k AND UNRATE < 4.5 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 99 index during manufacturing slowdown regimes signals sector contraction that reduces corporate output and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >55% of instances where INDPRO < 99 during the 2005-2024 sample period.
